about_this_file: Invented mail for a Principal Engineer leading an AI-RAN part in a Beyond 5G research group at a large electronics company's Bangalore R&D centre, with HQ in Suwon and Seoul. No real person, address or message. Most senders sit above manager and tech lead level. Dates like {day+2} are filled in relative to the day the eval runs. Used by mail_matrix.py --cases.

persona.about:
Name: Ananya Krishnan
Role: Principal Engineer and Part Leader, AI-RAN, Beyond 5G Research Group, R&D centre, Bangalore
Their mail addresses: ananya.krishnan@corp.example
People who matter most to them, in their own words:
Vikram Desai is my Group Head and my manager. Dr. Suresh Menon is VP and head of the Advanced Communications Lab. Dr. Jae-won Park leads 6G research at Seoul HQ and is my main HQ counterpart. Min-ji Lee runs 3GPP standards planning in Suwon. Rohit Bansal is the NTN tech lead in my part; Farah Siddiqui and Deepak Joshi are engineers in my part.
Tone for anything written as them: polite, brief and precise
persona.personal:
# What's important to me

- High: Vikram, Dr. Menon and Dr. Park; 3GPP RAN1 contribution deadlines; operator trial issues; patent filing deadlines; budget and headcount for my part; anything HQ asks me to deliver by a date.
- Normal: my team's review requests and leave approvals, interview panels, conference program committee work.
- Low: celebrations, cafeteria and transport notices, town hall recaps, newsletters, conference spam, vendor marketing, simulation farm job notices.
- I am a part leader: I approve my team's leave and travel, and people-manager actions apply to me.
